attacks.name: Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Push|: Before damage is dealt, this character may Push the defender Away |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Cosmic Blast
steps: |!wild| |*Sap Power|: Before damage is dealt, the defender loses 1 |!power| for each |!wild| in the attack roll, and this character gains that amount of |!power|.

attacks.name: Unleash the Cube
steps: If this attack deals |!damage|, after it is resolved this character may Throw the defender |!range_small|.

|!wild| |*Reality Warp|: After this attack is resolved, the defender and each other character within |!range| 1 of it gain the |§stun§Stun| special condition. This character is not affected by |*Reality Warp|.

superPowers.name: Master of Evil (Affiliation: Cabal)
superPowers.body: Each time an allied character damages an enemy character with an attack, after the attack is resolved the attacking character gains 1 |!power|.

superPowers.name: Cosmic Cube
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character gains 3 |!power|. Roll five dice. If the roll contains any |!failure| results, this character suffers 2 |!damage|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Master of the Cube
superPowers.body: Choose this character or another allied character within |!range| 4. Place the chosen character within |!range| 2 of its current position. A character can be Placed by this superpower only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Hail Hydra
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by an attack, it may use this superpower. Choose another allied character within |!range| 2 to become the new target of the attack regardless of |!range| or LOS.

Cosmic Cube reworked: it now deals a flat 2 |!damage| if the roll contains any |!failure| result, instead of 1 |!damage| per |!failure| rolled.
